meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 装好后,你请它修 LazyCodex 或 Codex 相关 bug 时,它会在临时目录复现问题、写回归测试、做最小修复并验证,然后按归属提交:openai/codex 的缺陷发 fork PR,LazyCodex 自己的缺陷发带补丁的 issue。
howto.when: 当用户要求修复 bug、贡献 bug 修复或为 bug 开 PR 等场景触发,尤其是 LazyCodex 或 Codex 相关缺陷。
howto.what_en: Claude reproduces the bug in a fresh temp workspace, writes a failing test, applies the smallest fix, verifies it, then opens a fork PR for upstream Codex or files a verified-fix issue for LazyCodex.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, open a PR for a bug, or debug a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

say_en.text: Fix this LazyCodex bug and file a verified-fix issue.
say_en.note: It reproduces, tests, patches, then creates the issue.

say_en.text: Debug this Codex CLI issue and open a PR to openai/codex.
say_en.note: It pushes a fork branch and creates the PR with logs.
